  </div>
  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>Block B — primitive-concept dependency and gap register
      <span class="ws-block-note">appendix snapshot: <b>2026-04-26</b> &middot; re-verified by us on <span class="f-date"><span class="seg d"></span>/<span class="seg m"></span>/<span class="seg y"></span></span></span></h2>
    <div class="f-select" style="margin:1mm 0 2mm">
      <span class="opt">Project-wide rules</span><span class="opt">Scope-attached rules</span><span class="opt">User-scope rules</span>
      <span class="opt">Persona or specialist agent</span><span class="opt">Skill (module entrypoint)</span><span class="opt">Prompt or repeatable workflow</span>
      <span class="opt">Memory (cross-session)</span><span class="opt">Hooks (event-driven)</span><span class="opt">MCP server config</span><span class="opt">Session compaction or restart</span>
    </div>
    <div class="prior" style="padding:2mm 3mm;margin:1mm 0 2mm">
      <b>Named gotchas from the appendix</b> <span class="prior-src">appx-A L47-99</span>
      <span style="display:block">Copilot — an over-eager <code>applyTo: "**"</code> matches every path, consumes the eager-preload budget, and can prevent lazy skills from being selected.</span>
      <span style="display:block">Claude Code — closest-wins shadowing means an always-on rule must live at the root; a large root file pulls into every session and crowds out the skill activation budget.</span>
      <span style="display:block">Cursor — user-scope rules live in IDE settings, not the filesystem, so they are not version-controlled; this creates hidden per-developer state and a silent-onboarding failure. Skills activation is partial.</span>
      <span style="display:block">Codex CLI — skills materialise to cross-tool <code>.agents/</code>, not under <code>.codex/</code>; there is no separate prompts primitive.</span>
      <span style="display:block">OpenCode — no native hooks concept; its convention set is the youngest in the matrix.</span>
    </div>

        <th><span class="fno">13</span> Workaround owner</th>
      </tr></thead>
